sentences.en: Stars emit gamma rays at the time of their explosion.
sentences.zh: 恒星在爆炸时会发出伽马射线。

sentences.en: This tells you how much carbon dioxide the building emits.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了你这座建筑排放了多少二氧化碳。

sentences.en: How much carbon dioxide does Algeria emit in the atmosphere?
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚向大气中排放了多少二氧化碳？
